headline: Nasdaq Plunges as AI Financing Anxieties Batter Investor Risk Sentiment
summary: The Nasdaq posted its worst single-day drop since June as mounting concerns over the massive costs and financing of artificial intelligence initiatives weighed heavily on risk sentiment.
why: The Nasdaq is a major global stock exchange heavily weighted toward technology and growth companies driving the artificial intelligence boom.

impacts.name: Technology Sector
impacts.why: Concerns over heavy AI infrastructure spending and financing weighed down major tech equities.

why_moved: Widespread investor anxiety surrounding the heavy financial outlays required for artificial intelligence buildouts triggered a broad sell-off across tech stocks.
